race.comment: MAGNETIC EDGE (4) is worth following up after scoring dominantly in town at the latest over 2525m when well found in an open market. The move back to 2050m is supported by a long, proven record around this trip. TOWER OF TUSCANY (3) is the main threat on recent efforts, dropping out of BM64 Saturday company after a sound third behind Longer Route. AKITU (1) hasn't placed in five previous starts around 2050m, but his recent Morphettville runs came in BM64 and BM62 company and this is a more suitable set-up. TAN TAT GOLD (2) brings a different profile, having been held up before missing by a head at Gawler in CL1 grade, and his proven track-and-trip record keeps him in the mix. THE PUNK ROCKER (6) has run well over this track and trip without saluting and gets a key booking in Toeroek. Keeping safe for a minor slot.
